targets.expr: (max(loki_process_custom_bots_online{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}) and on() (sum(namedprocess_namegroup_num_procs{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", groupname="coreserver"}) > 0)) or on() ((sum(namedprocess_namegroup_num_procs{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", groupname="coreserver"}) == 0) - 1)

(max(loki_process_custom_bots_online_albion{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}) and on() (sum(namedprocess_namegroup_num_procs{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", groupname="coreserver"}) > 0)) or on() ((sum(namedprocess_namegroup_num_procs{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", groupname="coreserver"}) == 0) - 1)

panels.title: 📊 Bots online by realm
panels.description: Per realm and total. Gaps = server stopped or collector off.

targets.expr: (label_replace(max(loki_process_custom_bots_online_albion{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}), "realm", "Albion", "", "") or label_replace(max(loki_process_custom_bots_online_midgard{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}), "realm", "Midgard", "", "") or label_replace(max(loki_process_custom_bots_online_hibernia{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}), "realm", "Hibernia", "", "")) and on() (sum(namedprocess_namegroup_num_procs{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", groupname="coreserver"}) > 0)
sum by (event) (rate(loki_process_custom_lines_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", event=~"$event", event!="other", level="INF"}[5m])) * 60
topk(10, sum by (event) (increase(loki_process_custom_lines_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", event=~"$event", event!="other"}[$__range])))
